authoritative_species_evidence.source: National Museum of Nature and Science Japan thistle database
supported: ordinary flowers are nodding at anthesis and become upright after flowering
upright-flowering plants are reported from multiple localities
white-flowered plants are recognized as Shirobana-kiseruazami
authoritative_species_evidence.boundary: No locality-specific co-segregation of white/non-white and anthesis-upright/nodding is established.

evidence: C. sieboldii herbarium records from former Tsukude-mura (Iwanami and Higashitahara)

tsukude_aichi.route_role: priority locality set for dense intraspecific-variation census; not evidence of orientation or colour co-segregation

cs0_priority: Kurumayama Moor / Kirigamine: verify white vs non-white frequency and A1-A2 orientation variation
Tsukude Plateau wetland local set: verify A1-A2 orientation variation and search for colour variation
decision.reason: Public sources establish both trait dimensions somewhere in the species but do not establish same-population or tightly matched local-set co-segregation.

hard_boundaries: post-anthesis upright heads are not upright-flowering morphs
white-form locality does not imply orientation polymorphism
